title.ko: 속담과 격언: Actions speak louder than words · Every cloud has a silver lining · Don't count your chickens · A stitch in time
title.en: proverbs and sayings: actions speak louder than words, every cloud has a silver lining, don't count your chickens, a stitch in time

explain.ko: 속담(proverb)은 오랜 경험에서 나온 지혜를 짧게 압축한 고정 표현입니다. Actions speak louder than words(행동이 말보다 낫다), Every cloud has a silver lining(불행 중 다행), A stitch in time saves nine(제때 손보면 큰일을 막는다)처럼 비유와 운율을 가집니다. 대화와 연설에서 생각을 생생하게 전달하지만, 지나치면 진부해지고 서로 모순되는 속담(Look before you leap / He who hesitates is lost)도 있으므로 상황에 맞게 골라야 합니다.
explain.en: A proverb is a short, fixed expression of wisdom drawn from long experience. Proverbs such as Actions speak louder than words, Every cloud has a silver lining and A stitch in time saves nine use figures and rhythm. They convey ideas vividly in conversation and speeches, but overuse sounds clichéd, and some proverbs contradict each other (Look before you leap / He who hesitates is lost), so choose to suit the situation.

items.passage:
COLUMN
The power of proverbs
Proverbs are short but carry long experience. 'Actions speak louder than words' reminds us of the importance of deeds over words. But proverbs sometimes contradict one another, so they must be used carefully to suit the situation.

trans.ko:

task.model: Your new business looks promising, but don't count your chickens before they hatch. Haste makes waste, so check the plan step by step. A stitch in time saves nine when it comes to small problems. Every cloud has a silver lining: even failure always teaches something.

model_trans.ko: 새 사업이 잘될 것 같지만 결과가 나오기 전에 장담하지는 마세요. 서두르면 일을 망치니 계획을 차근차근 점검하세요. 작은 문제를 제때 해결하면 큰 비용을 막을 수 있어요. 불행 중 다행으로, 실패해도 배울 점은 반드시 있어요.
model_trans.en: Your new business looks promising, but don't count your chickens before they hatch. Haste makes waste, so check the plan step by step. A stitch in time saves nine when it comes to small problems. Every cloud has a silver lining: even failure always teaches something.
